mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 4 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 8, low 3.

Thousands gathered in Pristina today, holding signs that read "Grandmother tolerates, mother silent, I scream" to demand an end to violence against women.

Former England striker Raheem Sterling was sentenced to twelve months in prison for careless driving after a crash involving his Lamborghini, though he avoided immediate custody by receiving a suspended term.

North Macedonia's prime minister Hristijan Mickoski announced that newly married couples up to age 35 will be eligible for state-backed home purchases at prices 20 % lower than market rates.

Former French president Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife, singer Carla Bruni, are slated to face a trial in Paris in 2027 over allegations they paid a witness to give false testimony.

Kosovar surgeon Dr. Zatriqi described the profound emotional toll on women undergoing mastectomy for breast cancer, noting many also lose a sense of partnership and identity after the operation.
